verdict.rationale: Airwallex provides dedicated APIs directly relevant to accounting data — the Card Expenses API for retrieving/syncing approved expenses into ERP/accounting systems, and the Bills API for managing vendor invoices/accounts payable — plus a broader Spend module for reconciling global company spend. However, there is no evidence of a single unified 'accounting' API/object model (e.g., ledger entries, chart of accounts, journal entries) beyond expenses and bills. missing for 10: evidence of a general ledger/chart-of-accounts API, independent developer corroboration of the accounting APIs working end-to-end.
